# Glitchling (`0thernes/glitchling-jam`, v2.4.0)

> A deliberately broken baby clone of A-Life Creature #1, featuring a repeatable TypeScript reference simulation (`glitchling.ts`), a 3D spiking-brain Geodesic Biodome (`live/`), a pure zero-Mathlib 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal core (`lean/`, 11 Palomar `module` files, 72 audited declarations), an interactive Proof Blueprint (`blueprint/`), an independent exact Python reference oracle (`reference/`), and an AMS-LaTeX scientific preprint (`paper/`, `dist/`).
